title: local-render render pack manifest (render.json)
description: Describes a render pack: a self-contained project that renders one video on the user's own machine.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Packs written for this schema use "1.0".

description.description: One or two sentences about what the video shows.

engine.description: Which engine adapter renders this pack.

entry.description: Main source file, relative to the pack root (for example src/index.html or src/scene.py).

output.description: Output file name written next to render.json (no folders).

duration.description: Length of the video in seconds.

codec.description: Video codec family. The renderer picks the fastest encoder for it (VideoToolbox, NVENC or software).

audio.description: Optional audio file to mux into the video, relative to the pack root.

requires.description: External tools the render needs, with minimum versions.

dependencies.description: Package dependencies installed into the pack folder at render time (never globally).

npm.description: npm packages, name -> exact version. Installed from the package.json named in npm_dir.

npm_dir.description: Folder containing package.json, relative to the pack root.

pip.description: Python packages, name -> version spec. Informational: render-run reports them and asks before installing.

command.description: The one command a person runs on macOS/Linux from the pack folder.

windows_command.description: The one command a person runs on Windows from the pack folder.

engine_command.description: The underlying engine invocation run.sh performs, for transparency.

relpath.description: A relative path inside the pack using forward slashes. No absolute paths, drive letters or '..' segments.
